description: This file defines functions and data structures for managing H264 video level limits, including mapping levels to maximum parameters, checking if certain encoding parameters are within limits, and finding suitable levels based on encoding constraints.

classes.name: LevelLimits
classes.description: A struct representing maximum limits for macroblock processing rate, frame size, decoded picture buffer size, and bitrate for a specific H264 level.

methods.name: LevelToLevelLimits
methods.description: Maps a H264 level identifier to its corresponding maximum limits.

methods.name: H264LevelToMaxMBPS
methods.description: Returns the maximum macroblock processing rate for a given level.

methods.name: H264LevelToMaxFS
methods.description: Returns the maximum frame size in macroblocks for a given level.

methods.name: H264LevelToMaxDpbMbs
methods.description: Returns the maximum decoded picture buffer size in macroblocks for a given level.

methods.name: H264ProfileLevelToMaxBR
methods.description: Calculates the maximum bitrate based on profile and level.

methods.name: CheckH264LevelLimits
methods.description: Checks if given encoding parameters are within the limits for a specific profile and level.

methods.name: FindValidH264Level
methods.description: Finds a suitable H264 level that satisfies the given encoding constraints.
